quarterly_data.quarter: Jacobs Solutions press release: Jacobs to deploy data center digital twin for NVIDIA's R&D (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA selected Jacobs to deploy its Data Center Digital Twin (built on NVIDIA Omniverse libraries) for a large-scale NVIDIA AI research and development facility in the United States under a three-year software-as-a-service agreement, to enhance operational planning and facility performance.
